items.heading: Pepperpot
details: Key ingredients: meat, cassareep, cinnamon, chili
Simmer tough cuts of meat slowly with cassareep, a dark cassava extract.
Add cinnamon, chili and warm spices.
Cook for hours until the meat is fork-tender and the sauce is thick and glossy.
Serve traditionally with bread, especially around the holidays.

items.heading: Cook-up Rice
details: Key ingredients: rice, coconut milk, pigeon peas, salted meat
Cook pigeon peas with salted meat until nearly tender.
Add coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Stir in rice and enough liquid to cook it through.
Cover and cook until the rice is fluffy and infused with coconut flavor.

items.heading: Roti
details: Ingredients: flour, water, salt and fat; yeast or leavening when required.
Mix into a soft dough, rest, shape or roll, then cook on a hot griddle or bake until cooked and lightly browned.

details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.

Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.

items.heading: Chicken Curry
details: Ingredients: main vegetable/protein, onion, garlic, ginger, spices, tomato or coconut, oil and salt.
